costBasis: Per-instance cost averaged within each scenario, then across the four scenarios; not actual billing. Plan runs (anthropic, openai) are priced by their share of the $100 plan's weekly quota times its weekly cost; the rest in USD

instanceCost.deepseek: Benchmark instance cost.usd: per-request official price list, peak / off-peak by request time
instanceCost.anthropic: Benchmark instance cost.usd (Claude Code total_cost_usd, API-equivalent USD), as a share of the $100 plan's weekly quota (planCost), times the plan's weekly cost
instanceCost.openai: Token counts priced at the rates below (API-equivalent USD), as a share of the $100 plan's weekly quota (planCost), times the plan's weekly cost
instanceCost.strata: Local running cost from the instance work seconds and the localRunningCost settings below
instanceCost.google: Token counts priced at the rates below (output includes thinking); the benchmark ran on a Google plan login, so this is a reference API price

strata-iq3_xxs.notes: Home PC with an RTX 3080 Ti 12 GB, i9-13900 and 64 GB RAM. 400 W is a rough whole-system load estimate (350 W GPU board limit; memory-bound decoding usually draws less). Electricity is the Q1 2026 world household average (country-weighted). Maintenance covers wear parts at about USD 50 a year over about 2,500 loaded hours.

planCost.formula: cost USD = (API-equivalent USD of the run / weeklyApiEquivalentUsd) x (monthlyUsd / daysPerMonth x 7)

anthropic.basis: Measured on the local Claude Max 20x plan on 2026-11-18: K = 0.0466 percentage points of weekly quota per API-priced USD at 11% used (usage.sh --calibrate), so a full week is 100 / 0.0466 = about $2,146 of API-priced use; the $100 plan is taken as 1/4 of the Max 20x quota. A 1% rounding step at 11% used is about +/-9%, and Claude Code's recorded run cost uses its own price list, so treat the factor as about +/-10%.

openai.basis: Measured on the local Codex $20 plan on 2026-11-18: 45% of the weekly quota used = about $21.15 of API-priced active use, so about $47.0 per week (limits/codex.json conversion, auto-review and credit-paid calls excluded); the $100 plan has 10 times the $20 plan's weekly quota (user's figure), so $470. Rates are the same as the page's OpenAI rates.
